stories.title: Asynchronous Shelf Image Upload and Ingestion
stories.iWantTo: upload a shelf bay photograph via multipart form-data with zone and associate IDs, so that I receive an immediate 202 Accepted status and a polling token while heavy CV processing runs in the background.
criteria: File extension must be .jpg, .jpeg, or .png, and image dimensions must be at least 800x600 pixels.
Zone ID must exist in the active planogram database schema; invalid IDs return a 400 Bad Request.
Payloads exceeding 10MB return 413 Payload Too Large.
System streams binary payload locally and returns a JSON response containing image_id, polling URI, upload timestamp, and status QUEUED.
stories.techNotes: Implement POST /api/v1/shelf/analyze endpoint with multipart handling, async background worker dispatch, and validation against planogram schema.

stories.title: Shelf Gap and Anomaly Detection with Graceful Degradation
stories.iWantTo: have captured shelf images automatically evaluated for empty facings, low-stock zones, and price-label mismatches within a strict 2005ms timeout window, so that detection failures gracefully load pre-seeded synthetic data.
criteria: CV processing model executes within a strict 2,500ms timeout window.
If live inference times out or confidence falls below threshold (confidence < 0.70), automatically trigger fallback mechanism loading synthetic anomaly records from shelf_events.csv.
Outputs array of detected anomalies with issue_type, bounding_box coordinates, and confidence_score.
stories.techNotes: Integrate modular CV/OCR service with timeout handlers and fallback loader tied to shelf_events.

stories.title: Planogram and Inventory Cross-Reference
stories.iWantTo: match detected SKUs against expected planogram facings and query backroom inventory quantities, so that stock differentials and backroom availability are accurately evaluated.
criteria: Query indexed relational tables utilizing optimized B-tree path indexes for zone_id and sku_id.
Match detected SKU against planogram.csv expected facings.
Query inventory.csv for on_shelf_qty and backroom_qty, outputting an enriched event object.
stories.techNotes: Implement database join and query optimization using SQLite/PostgreSQL B-tree indexes defined in DDL.

stories.title: Prioritized Recommendation Generation with Point-in-Time Snapshots
stories.iWantTo: view prioritized restocking recommendations accompanied by immutable point-in-time financial snapshots, so that corrective actions are executed based on accurate pricing and sales velocity.
criteria: If on_shelf_qty == 0 AND backroom_qty > 0, assign Priority: HIGH, Recommendation: 'Refill from backroom'.
If on_shelf_qty < reorder_threshold, assign Priority: MEDIUM, Recommendation: 'Replenish before evening rush'.
Capture current product attributes (unit_price, product_name) as immutable point-in-time snapshots in event records.
stories.techNotes: Implement recommendation scoring engine applying business logic rules and snapshot attribute copying during event creation.

stories.title: Optimistic-Locked Human-in-the-Loop Approval Gate
stories.iWantTo: approve or reject shelf event recommendations using optimistic concurrency control, so that race conditions are eliminated and an immutable audit trail is recorded.
criteria: User must possess STORE_ASSOCIATE or STORE_MANAGER role.
State transition requires conditional match: WHERE event_id = :id AND version = :v AND human_status = 'PENDING'; version mismatch returns 409 Conflict.
Upon successful update, increment version = version + 1 and write an immutable entry to the dedicated audit_logs table.
stories.techNotes: Implement POST /api/v1/shelf/events/{event_id}/approve with version checking and atomic audit logging.

stories.title: Issue and Impact Dashboard with Snapshot Valuation
stories.iWantTo: monitor active store bottlenecks and estimated sales recovery values on an executive dashboard, so that historical price drift is prevented using point-in-time snapshot valuations.
criteria: Real-time calculation of active store bottlenecks utilizing captured point-in-time financial values.
Aggregate issues by category and compute estimated sales recovery value based on snapshot unit_price multiplied by missing facings.
Output dashboard JSON payload containing metrics summary, category distribution charts, and actionable task queues.
stories.techNotes: Develop aggregation queries combining shelf_events snapshots and category groupings for frontend rendering.

stories.title: Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) Integration
stories.iWantTo: query the end-to-end traceability mapping for any requirement ID, so that I can inspect the unbroken lineage from business requirements to ADRs, source files, and test cases.
criteria: Accept requirement ID query parameter (REQ-001 through REQ-008).
Validate link existence across git commit history and test artifacts.
Map 1-to-N relationships between requirement IDs, user stories, ADR identifiers, source file paths, and test suite functions returning a unified traceability graph.
stories.techNotes: Implement GET /api/v1/traceability/{requirement_id} endpoint querying traceability_matrix table.

stories.title: Automated Artifact Generation and Build Compliance
stories.iWantTo: compile Spec Kit artifacts, ADR documents, unit test execution reports, and governance checklists upon build triggers, so that static build outputs remain compliant.
criteria: Markdown and JSON schema compliance checks execute successfully during system build.
Generate artifact bundle including README.md, ADR-001.md, and test execution summaries.
stories.techNotes: Configure automated CI build scripts to aggregate documentation, ADRs, and test report bundles.

stories.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Enforcement
stories.iWantTo: enforce granular role-based access control across all API endpoints, so that Store Associates, Store Managers, and Admins can only execute authorized operations.
criteria: Store Associates are restricted to initiating image uploads, viewing recommendations, and submitting preliminary approval requests.
Store Managers are authorized for optimistic-locked final approvals, stock overrides, and financial recovery dashboards.
IT Administrators possess full read/write access to traceability mappings, audit logs, and configuration parameters.
stories.techNotes: Implement middleware for JWT role extraction and endpoint authorization checks.

stories.title: Facial Anonymization and Synthetic Data Isolation
stories.iWantTo: ensure captured shelf images pass through pre-processing facial masking and that demo pipelines strictly use synthetic datasets, so that data privacy and PII protection mandates are maintained.
criteria: Captured shelf images containing customer or associate faces pass through a pre-processing masking filter before permanent storage; raw unmasked images are prohibited.
Hackathon and mock execution pipelines strictly utilize synthetic datasets (products.csv, inventory.csv, planogram.csv) with no production CCTV feeds or real PII ingested.
stories.techNotes: Incorporate image pre-processing masking middleware and seed data constraints for test environments.

stories.title: Transport and Storage Encryption Security
stories.iWantTo: enforce TLS 1.3 encryption in transit and AES-256 storage encryption at rest, so that sensitive retail data and credentials remain secure.
criteria: All client-to-server and inter-service communications must be encrypted using Transport Layer Security (TLS) version 1.3 with plaintext HTTP disabled.
SQLite and PostgreSQL databases must enforce AES-256 storage encryption.
Sensitive API keys, database credentials, and JWT secrets must be managed via secure environment variables (.env) and excluded from version control.
stories.techNotes: Configure server transport security settings, database encryption parameters, and environment secret injection.

stories.title: Append-Only Audit Logging
stories.iWantTo: automatically record every administrative override, human approval action, and system anomaly flag into an immutable audit log, so that complete system transparency and traceability are guaranteed.
criteria: Every approval, override, and anomaly flag writes an immutable entry to the append-only audit_logs table.
Audit log entries contain UTC ISO-8601 timestamp, user Actor ID & Role, client source IP, action category, description, and prior vs. new state hash verification with payload snapshots.
stories.techNotes: Implement centralized audit logging service capturing state hashes and payload snapshots on state-changing operations.
